lifecycle.request_id: one user intent across Streamlit, Agent assistance and deterministic execution
lifecycle.task_id: one bounded unit of work; revisions retain the same task_id
lifecycle.run_id: one concrete tool or deterministic execution; null before execution starts
lifecycle.task_revision: positive integer used to reject stale review or approval

rules: IDs are opaque non-path identifiers and do not contain user or sample data.
A request may contain multiple tasks and each task may contain multiple runs.
Receipts and result packages must carry request_id, task_id, run_id and task_revision.
Platform camelCase fields and SteelAI snake_case fields carry identical values.
Correlation identity grants no permission, approval or evidence status.
